cohort.fullPlayLimit: PlaySim.run owns the engine natural finish/timeout; no collector override

definitions.keeperContinuity: The keeper owned a real live hand-joint object before the transfer, and the same per-play WeakMap ID is the primary hand object after the controller and next solved tick. A later real shed may remove it.
definitions.nativeLoadedPair: positivePairForceAfterSolve uses the surviving live keeper↔defender afterSolvedJoint mean normal/tangent force for every keeper, including TE Y. It does not require an OL deliveredStep row.
definitions.olDeliveredLoadScope: hasOLDeliveredLoad marks the separate per-body deliveredStep record, which this collector writes only for LT/LG/C/RG/RT. positiveOLPairForceAfterSolve and positiveOLKeeperArmImpulse are null when that row is absent, not false. Per-body arm impulse contains all hand/strike loads and is not attributed solely to the keeper pair. TE impulses are not inferred from joint force.
definitions.weakHelperSecurePrimary: Actual scheduled combination reads with helperSupport<.25 and e.baseB>.60, |e.phi|<.55, control>-.06. This conservative control threshold passes every urgency value; it does not prove all other backer/dwell/candidate conditions.
definitions.initialProjection: Fixed original body/profile/ratings/snap timing/plan/combination state. New diagnostic fields are omitted; both full projections and hashes must match.
definitions.gains: Paired ordinary natural-end rushing gains; all adverse differences retained. The balanced160 is not a natural NFL concept distribution or roster population.
definitions.nativeUnits: Force kg·yd/s², impulse kg·yd/s, work kg·yd²/s²; no unconverted N or N·s labels.
definitions.physicsLimits: Max positive excess on OL native loads at retained controller ticks. Global residuals and support-motor excess are recorded on every solved tick by the collector.

limitations: Two separately labelled recovery witnesses use a second roster pair and are excluded from ordinary160 results.
Receiver/LB/RB controllers and schemes were not validated merely by a cleaner handover; rushing gains can worsen after a mechanically feasible transfer.
Joint field forces are tick means and only include hands that survive solver/cleanup; missing post-solve hands are not automatically a discontinuity bug.
Collection runtime includes read-only observation, full replay records on fixed10, and independent plain reruns for all162; not a physics solver benchmark.
